refnamediv.refpurpose: Finds lines in a binary image using the standard Hough transform

listitem.para: Output matrix of lines. Each column represents a line, coded in polar coordinates system (rho, theta). (double 2xn).

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: HoughLines find the lines in an image using the standard Hough transform. To apply, first an edge detection pre-processing is necessary. It keeps track of the intersection between curves of every point in the image. If the number of intersections is above the value of threshold, then the line is output in polar coordinates (rho, theta).
